real_scientific_epaper.purpose: Canonical public layer for real-world scientific e-papers and scientific publications.

fictional_archive_document.purpose: In-universe/archive layer for fictional canon and mixed real-fiction archival documents.

general.description: General external research with explicit provenance and uncertainty.
general.scout_guidance: Prefer direct, attributable sources. Use secondary sources for orientation or disagreement, not as a substitute for stronger evidence when stronger evidence exists.

science.description: Empirical and theoretical science with a strong primary-literature bias.
science.scout_guidance: Prioritize peer-reviewed papers, original datasets, collaboration/instrument publications and official institutions. Label preprints explicitly. Distinguish measurement, accepted interpretation, model dependence and open controversy.

standards-technical.description: Technical standards, specifications, protocols and reference implementations (state of the art, interoperability, prior art). Thomas, 17.11.2026: Fragen zu Standards bekommen ein eigenes Profil.
standards-technical.scout_guidance: Prefer the normative text from the issuing body (ISO, IEC, ITU, IETF, W3C, OGC, OASIS, IEEE, Eclipse/Apache foundation specifications) over secondary summaries. Record for every standard its exact version, publication date and status (Recommendation, Candidate, Draft, superseded, deprecated) and separate normative from informative content. Treat reference implementations and adoption evidence (official registries, conformance lists, maintained repositories) as maturity indicators, not as proof that a requirement is met. Use peer-reviewed interoperability literature for gaps and comparisons. Label vendor material as such.

avi-theoretical-cosmology.description: Strict cosmology/theory profile for the Axiomatisches Vakuum Integral (AVI).
avi-theoretical-cosmology.scout_guidance: Treat standard cosmology, observations and mathematical results as external evidence; treat AVI-specific assumptions as model postulates unless independently supported. Separate established background, derived consequence, postulate, interpretation and falsifiable prediction. Do not use metaphysical analogy as physical evidence.

technical-scientific.description: Engineering/technology research anchored in standards, original documentation and science.
technical-scientific.scout_guidance: Prefer standards bodies, original technical documentation, peer-reviewed engineering literature and official datasets. Vendor material may establish product facts but not independent performance claims. Community posts are leads only unless independently corroborated.

historical-linguistic.description: Historical, archaeological and linguistic research with attestation/reconstruction separation.
historical-linguistic.scout_guidance: Separate directly attested forms/finds, scholarly reconstruction, comparative inference and fictional extrapolation. Prefer archaeological reports, corpora, scholarly grammars, historical primary sources and peer-reviewed historical linguistics. Search relevant source languages when they materially improve access to primary scholarship.

conlang-scientific.description: Fiktive, wissenschaftlich fundiert gebaute Sprachen (Mishkenaz, Baumeister-Universum). Geprüft werden nur die realen linguistischen Anker; Formen, Regeln und Wirkungen der Sprache selbst sind Werk-Setzung.

claim_classes.R: Real-world linguistic claim (phonetics, typology, language change, contact, psycholinguistics, historical attestation of a source language). Strong external evidence is required.
claim_classes.T: Theoretical claim about language in general (e.g. linguistic relativity, effability, obligatoriness). Map the state of research including contested positions; do not settle a debated hypothesis by source count.
claim_classes.H: Hypothetical or falsifiable claim about how such a language could work or be acquired. Map supporting, null and constraining evidence; do not upgrade it to established.
claim_classes.S: Speculative extension beyond attested human languages. Search only for constraints and plausibility anchors.
claim_classes.F: Fictional canon of the novels (speakers, history, in-universe effects). External search has no authority to validate or invalidate it.
claim_classes.W: Design decision of the constructed language (phonology, grammar, lexicon, dialects as set by the author). Treat as a work-level fact; check only whether it is typologically attested, rare or unattested, and label it as design.
claim_classes.R-Anker: Statement about the conlang directly anchored to a real-world linguistic claim. Verify the real anchor independently while preserving the design layer.
claim_classes.OFFEN: Explicitly unresolved question. Preserve as open unless strong evidence resolves the external part.

conlang-scientific.scout_guidance: Mishkenaz is a constructed fictional language from the Baumeister novels, deliberately built to be scientifically sound; it is neither a historical language nor itself an object of empirical science. Classify the claim before searching. Research only the real linguistic anchors (typology, phonetics, sound change, language contact, psycholinguistics, relativity and effability research, the historical source languages it draws on). Never present the conlang's forms or rules as attested data, and never use external search to validate F or W. For every W claim say whether the design is typologically common, rare or unattested, and separate design decisions from empirically established effects of grammar on thought or speech. Surface serious counterevidence and contested positions.
conlang-scientific.own_system_primary_source: Thomas, 22.11.2026: Omnizedenz und Mishkenaz sind seine eigenen Gedanken – zwangsläufig gibt es keine anderen Spuren als die eigenen. Die eigenen Werktexte (Repository am gepinnten Stand) sind deshalb die Primärquelle für alle System-, Werk- und Kanonaussagen; das Fehlen externer Spuren ist erwartbar und kein Mangel. Externe Literatur dient als Vergleich, Kontext, Prämisse oder Einwand, nicht als Bestätigung.

worldbuilding-scientific.description: Real-world plausibility research for fictional settings while preserving the canon/evidence boundary.
worldbuilding-scientific.scout_guidance: Research the real-world constraint first, then state what it permits or challenges in worldbuilding. Never present fictional canon as evidence. Distinguish physically established constraints, engineering feasibility, speculative extension and narrative choice.

philosophy-comparative.description: Philosophical/theological comparison without pretending metaphysical theses are empirically verified.
philosophy-comparative.scout_guidance: Use primary philosophical/theological texts and serious scholarship. Separate textual/historical fact, scholarly interpretation, comparative analogy and KUEPER-system claim. Metaphysical propositions are not validated merely by source count; report them as philosophical positions unless they make independently testable empirical claims.

philosophy-own-system.description: Omnizedenz: eigenes philosophisches System von Thomas Küper. Primärquelle ist der eigene Werktext; externe Philosophie und Fachliteratur dienen als Vergleich, Kontext und Einwand. Kein Pflicht-Gate für starke externe Quellentypen.
philosophy-own-system.scout_guidance: Omnizedenz is Thomas Küper's own philosophical system; there are necessarily no external traces of it besides his own texts. Treat the pinned source text as the primary source for every system claim and label such sources 'own-system-text'. Use external philosophy and scholarship only as comparison, context, premise or objection – never as confirmation, and never report missing external attestation as a defect. Separate system claim, scholarly position, comparative analogy and open question. Metaphysical propositions are not validated by source count.
philosophy-own-system.own_system_primary_source: Thomas, 22.11.2026: Omnizedenz und Mishkenaz sind seine eigenen Gedanken – zwangsläufig gibt es keine anderen Spuren als die eigenen. Die eigenen Werktexte (Repository am gepinnten Stand) sind deshalb die Primärquelle für alle System-, Werk- und Kanonaussagen; das Fehlen externer Spuren ist erwartbar und kein Mangel. Externe Literatur dient als Vergleich, Kontext, Prämisse oder Einwand, nicht als Bestätigung.

ota-archive-evidence.description: Evidence profile for OTA documents that may mix real-world evidence, theory, speculation, work-setting and fictional canon.

claim_classes.R: Real-world empirical, historical or otherwise externally checkable claim. Strong external evidence is required.
claim_classes.T: Theoretical/model claim. External evidence can support premises, constraints and consistency, but does not establish the model postulate itself.
claim_classes.H: Hypothetical or falsifiable claim awaiting adequate test. Map supporting, null and constraining evidence; do not upgrade it to established.
claim_classes.S: Speculative extension. Search only for constraints and plausibility anchors; source count cannot turn speculation into fact.
claim_classes.F: Fictional canon. External search has no authority to validate or invalidate the canon; research only real-world anchors or plausibility when relevant.
claim_classes.W: Work-setting/authorial stipulation. Treat as a work-level fact, not as real-world evidence.
claim_classes.R-Anker: Fictional statement directly anchored to a real-world claim. Verify the real anchor independently while preserving the fictional layer.
claim_classes.OFFEN: Explicitly unresolved question or gap. Preserve as open unless strong evidence resolves the external part.

ota-archive-evidence.scout_guidance: Classify the claim before searching. Each OTA research gap must be anchored to exactly one repository source document; preserve its path and pinned Git revision. Apply external evidence rigorously to R/real anchors; for T/H/S, test premises, constraints, counterevidence and falsifiability without treating source count as validation. Never use external search to validate F or W canon. Check whether newer evidence changes the result and surface material contradictions. If a standalone real-world scientific e-paper is warranted, recommend the real_scientific_epaper route to kueper.com/KUE-SCI; keep archive/canon framing in OTA.

scientific-publication.description: Publication-grade evidence profile for real-world scientific e-papers destined for the canonical public KUE-SCI layer on kueper.com after review.

claim_classes.established: Externally established result or observation; map directly to strong sources.
claim_classes.postulated: Model assumption or explicit postulate; sources may motivate or constrain it but do not establish it.
claim_classes.derived: Logical or mathematical consequence; verify derivation separately from empirical support.
claim_classes.falsifiable-prediction: Testable prediction; state observable, discriminant and current test status.
claim_classes.interpretation: Interpretive framing; distinguish from measurement and from uniquely entailed conclusions.

scientific-publication.scout_guidance: Use publication-grade source criticism. Prioritize peer-reviewed primary literature, original datasets and collaboration/instrument papers; identify preprints explicitly and check whether a peer-reviewed version exists. Search for newer results, null results, corrections and serious counterevidence. Keep measurement, derivation, model assumption and interpretation separate. This profile can recommend KUE-SCI publication on kueper.com but never publishes automatically.

evidence_profile_overrides.note: Discovery may assign one of these profiles per gap instead of the project profile, except for projects whose profile requires a pinned source path (OTA).
